notes: recipeDraft matches BBC Good Food Apple strudel (100g sugar, 4 Granny Smith, 25g each currants/sultanas, 1 tsp allspice and nutmeg, 85g walnuts, 6 filo, 50g butter, 200C/180C fan, 25 min, freeze 6 months and bake 35-40 min); added a note that it uses shop-bought filo, not hand-stretched dough, as the article describes.
